load: Creates objectives, integer constants and command triggers, defaults difficulty to Normal, and sets the respawn radius.
init_player: Stores the player's UUID in four scores, enables command triggers and adds playerInit.
pre_tick: Runs pre_tick_player for every player before the main update.
pre_tick_player: Creates player2d on the dimension's lookup plane and initializes the starting chunk when no nearby marker exists.
tick: Updates players, projectiles, pearls and displays every tick; updates markers, proximity and interactions every four ticks.
tick_player: Handles dimension readiness, locked-chunk collision, UUID-matched projectiles and player command triggers.
post_tick: Refreshes every player's safe position, then removes temporary player2d markers.
post_tick_player: Records the latest safe position only outside locked chunks, then releases the currentChunk context.
tick_chunk_marker: Initializes loaded neighboring chunks when a player2d marker is nearby and propagation is incomplete.
tick_chunk_player_proximity_check: Compares current and previous proximity, then activates, deactivates or updates relevant locked chunks.
tick_chunk_interactions: Handles interaction clicks: dye changes the border color; other clicks show the item and remaining cost. Clears interaction state afterward.
tick_chunk_item_displays: Adjusts an item display's Y coordinate to the nearest player passing the dimension's render-height predicate.
tick_item_in_chunk: Sends player-thrown items for payment checks and marks items without a Thrower as already processed.
chunk_init/init_chunk_marker: Computes chunk coordinates and center, positions the marker, sets locked/unlocked state and exempts central End chunks without an End Crystal.
chunk_init/init_containing_chunk: Creates a marker at the execution position: currentPlayer produces an unlocked chunk; other callers produce a locked chunk. Centers the marker afterward.
chunk_init/init_neighbors: Checks north/east/south/west independently, avoids duplicate markers, waits for loaded areas and records initNeighborsDone once all sides are initialized.
chunk_init/init_neighbor_north: Creates the northern chunk at the caller's prepared position, then tags the original marker with initNeighborNorth.
chunk_init/init_neighbor_east: Creates the eastern chunk at the caller's prepared position, then tags the original marker with initNeighborEast.
chunk_init/init_neighbor_south: Creates the southern chunk at the caller's prepared position, then tags the original marker with initNeighborSouth.
chunk_init/init_neighbor_west: Creates the western chunk at the caller's prepared position, then tags the original marker with initNeighborWest.
chunk_init/init_locked_chunk: Creates dimension-colored border block displays, then initializes the required unlock item and cost.
chunk_init/init_locked_chunk_unlock_item: Uses a temporary armor stand to roll loot, stores data.source and remaining cost, records the difficulty tag and applies dimension/difficulty scaling.
chunk_proximity/on_chunk_become_relevant: Creates vertically stacked interaction hitboxes for clicks and mining protection when players approach a locked chunk.
chunk_proximity/on_chunk_cease_relevant: Removes item/text displays and interaction hitboxes when the locked chunk no longer has relevant nearby players.
chunk_proximity/tick_relevant_chunk: Renders unlock indicators and processes previously unprocessed item entities within the chunk's search bounds.
chunk_items/roll_chunk_unlock_item: Rolls the all_biome fallback, then replaces the armor stand's held item using the loot table matching the biome at its position.
chunk_items/check_submit_chunk_item: Finds the nearest locked marker, compares item IDs, identifies the thrower's UUID, dispatches success/failure, returns leftovers and clears shared context.
chunk_items/submit_chunk_item_success: Subtracts the submitted amount, consumes required items, preserves excess, unlocks when the remaining cost is nonpositive or refreshes displays if payment is incomplete.
chunk_items/submit_chunk_item_failure: Plays incorrect-item sound and particles; the caller returns the item to its thrower.
chunk_items/render_chunk_items: Requires a nearby unlocked neighbor, then checks each side for display creation using side-specific execution positions.
chunk_items/reset_chunk_items: Rerolls a marker's unlock requirement and updates existing displays.
chunk_items/update_chunk_items: Updates only rendered sides of a marker that is still locked.
chunk_items/kill_chunk_items: Positions execution bounds on all four sides and invokes each side's item/text display cleanup.
chunk_items/check_render_chunk_item_nort: Creates a northern item display with a text passenger when that side is not rendered and a player is inside the caller's bounds; records its rendered tag.
chunk_items/check_render_chunk_item_east: Creates an eastern item display with a text passenger when that side is not rendered and a player is inside the caller's bounds; records its rendered tag.
chunk_items/check_render_chunk_item_sout: Creates a southern item display with a text passenger when that side is not rendered and a player is inside the caller's bounds; records its rendered tag.
chunk_items/check_render_chunk_item_west: Creates a western item display with a text passenger when that side is not rendered and a player is inside the caller's bounds; records its rendered tag.
chunk_items/update_chunk_item_north: Copies data.source to the northern item display and binds its text display to the remaining-cost score.
chunk_items/update_chunk_item_east: Copies data.source to the eastern item display and binds its text display to the remaining-cost score.
chunk_items/update_chunk_item_south: Copies data.source to the southern item display and binds its text display to the remaining-cost score.
chunk_items/update_chunk_item_west: Copies data.source to the western item display and binds its text display to the remaining-cost score.
chunk_items/kill_chunk_item_north: Removes chunkSideNorth entities within the caller's bounds and clears the marker's rendered tag.
chunk_items/kill_chunk_item_east: Removes chunkSideEast entities within the caller's bounds and clears the marker's rendered tag.
chunk_items/kill_chunk_item_south: Removes chunkSideSouth entities within the caller's bounds and clears the marker's rendered tag.
chunk_items/kill_chunk_item_west: Removes chunkSideWest entities within the caller's bounds and clears the marker's rendered tag.
collision/player_chunk_collision: Finds currentChunk, restores the safe position if it is locked, then clears currentChunk.
collision/exit_locked_chunk: Matches the player's prevPosMarker using all four UUID scores, retains current viewing rotation and teleports the player back to that marker.
collision/refresh_position_marker: Deletes the player's previous UUID-matched position marker and creates a new safe-position marker carrying the same owner UUID.
dimension/on_change_dimension: Adds awaitingDimensionLoad through @p and revokes @s's dimension-change advancement so the next transition can be detected.
dimension/on_dimension_loaded: Unlocks the destination chunk if it is locked after loading, then clears awaitingDimensionLoad.
projectile/init_projectile: Copies the projectile's four Owner UUID components into scores and adds projectileInit.
projectile/tick_player_projectile: Finds the player's projectile's current chunk and stops the projectile if the chunk is locked.
projectile/projectile_entered_locked_chu: Plays a sound, stops Motion, sets inGround/DealtDamage and adds projectileCollided to prevent repeated checks.
pearl/tick_ender_pearl: Checks an ender pearl's current chunk and dispatches destruction when it enters a locked chunk.
pearl/pearl_entered_locked_chunk: Creates particles and sound, then kills the pearl to prevent teleporting through a locked border.
chunk_difficulty/set_difficulty_easy: Selects level 1 before the first credited unlock; resets the datapack if changing levels and announces the new difficulty.
chunk_difficulty/set_difficulty_normal: Selects level 2 before the first credited unlock; resets the datapack if changing levels and announces the new difficulty.
chunk_difficulty/set_difficulty_hard: Selects level 3 before the first credited unlock; resets the datapack if changing levels and announces the new difficulty.
chunk_difficulty/set_difficulty_impossib: Selects level 4 before the first credited unlock; resets the datapack if changing levels and announces the new difficulty.
utils/find_chunk_coords: Computes ChunkX/ChunkZ from entity Pos scaled by 0.0625 through data get and scoreboard storage.
utils/find_chunk_center: Multiplies ChunkX/Z by 16 and adds 8 to produce chunk-center PosX/Z.
utils/find_current_chunk: Tags the nearest chunk marker within 12 blocks on the dimension's lookup plane as currentChunk; callers must invoke done_with_current_chunk afterward.
utils/find_nearest_locked_chunk: Tags the nearest locked marker within 15 blocks on the dimension's lookup plane as currentChunk; used for item payments.
utils/done_with_current_chunk: Clears the temporary currentChunk tag when a context-dependent operation finishes.
utils/unlock_current_chunk: Marks the chunk unlocked, removes visuals/interactions, increments world/payer progress and dispatches messages and advancements.
utils/render_chunk_unlock_message: Announces the payer and global unlock number, handles milestones 1/8/16/32/64/128 and respects hideChunkUnlockTitle.
utils/render_chunk_auto_unlock_message: Announces an unlock without attributing a payer, such as a locked portal destination becoming accessible.
utils/render_chunk_difficulty_message: Shows clickable difficulty commands; after the first credited unlock, shows the restriction and reset link instead.
utils/reroll_chunk: Allows rerolling only on Easy, selects a nearby locked marker in front of the player and increments reroll counters.
utils/dye_chunk: Selects the main-hand dye color, recolors the nearest locked marker's border displays, consumes one dye and grants the chunk_dye advancement.
utils/set_chunk_unlock_count_below_name: Displays ChunklockTotalUnlockedChunks below player names using below_name.
utils/spread_players: Runs spreadplayers for all players and assigns their resulting locations as new spawn points.
utils/uninstall: Removes selected objectives, temporary item-name storage, chunklock entities and playerInit, then disables file/chunklock; it does not erase every state value.
utils/reset: Runs uninstall, re-enables file/chunklock and invokes load again.
utils/translate_item_name/store_item_nam: Creates an item through an ID macro, extracts its translation key into chunklock:master storage and deletes the temporary item.
utils/translate_item_name/display_item_n: Uses a macro to show remaining cost and the translated item name to a chunkInteractor who is not using dye.
